english: Your location is used on this device to show where you are and to guide you. It is only sent when you choose to send a report, and then only the reported spot is stored. Reviews and reports are linked to your account so the community model can learn whose reports are reliable; other people only see combined alerts, never your name.
somali: Goobtaada waxaa lagu isticmaalaa qalabkan si loo muujiyo halka aad joogto loona hago. Waxaa la diraa oo keliya marka aad doorato inaad warbixin dirto, markaas waxaa la keydiyaa oo keliya meesha la soo sheegay. Faallooyinka iyo warbixinnada waxay ku xiran yihiin akoonkaaga si nidaamka bulshadu u barto warbixinnada la isku hallayn karo; dadka kale waxay arkaan oo keliya digniinaha la isku daray, marna magacaaga.

english: Roads and buildings come from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Places also come from Overture Maps. District boundaries come from OCHA / HDX. Satellite imagery is Esri World Imagery; the street map is OpenStreetMap. Routes are planned by OSRM through the Magaalo website, using OpenStreetMap roads. Community alerts and reviewed details come from Magaalo users. Map data can be incomplete or out of date.
somali: Waddooyinka iyo dhismayaasha waxay ka yimaadeen ka qaybgalayaasha OpenStreetMap (ODbL). Meelaha qaarkood waxay ka yimaadeen Overture Maps. Xuduudaha degmooyinka waxay ka yimaadeen OCHA / HDX. Sawirrada dayax-gacmeedka waa Esri World Imagery; khariidadda waddooyinka waa OpenStreetMap. Jidadka waxaa qorsheeya OSRM oo maraya bogga Magaalo, iyagoo adeegsanaya waddooyinka OpenStreetMap. Digniinaha bulshada iyo faahfaahinta la hubiyay waxay ka yimaadeen isticmaalayaasha Magaalo. Xogta khariidaddu waxay noqon kartaa mid aan dhammaystirnayn ama duugowday.
